name: Marble loaf cake
author: The Wickham family
steps: Cream butter and sugar, add yolks one at a time.
Beat egg whites until stiff fold into creamed mixture.
Dissolve cocoa in 3T of the boiling water.
Add remaining water to the cake mixture alternately with sifted flour and baking powder.
To one half add the cocoa and mix well.
Place the two mixtures alternately into a greased tin.
When cooled remove from tin and cool on a wire rack.
To make icing: Sift icing sugar, add softened butter and cocoa, mix together, add hot water to soft consistency.

culture.text: Cake is a baker's confectionery made by combining flour with a liquid, a fat or both, and usually with a leavening agent. Cakes are usually baked, but can be griddled. In their oldest forms, cakes were modifications of bread, but cakes now cover a wide range of preparations that can be simple or elaborate and which share features with other desserts such as pastries, meringues, custards, and pies.
